description: Fibonacci retracement and extension price levels from a swing high and low, for any asset (forex, stocks, crypto): retracement 0, 23.6, 38.2, 50, 61.8, 78.6 and 100 percent and extension 127.2, 161.8, 200 and 261.8 percent, as prices. direction "up" measures a rise from the low to the high, "down" a fall from the high to the low; 0 percent is the end of the swing and 100 percent its start. A level at or below zero (an extension of a steep fall) comes back as price null. The ratios are a charting convention, not a forecast. Pure price arithmetic, no pair or market data.

direction.description: "up": the swing rose from the low to the high; "down": it fell from the high to the low

high.description: Swing high price (positive, above the low, at most 1e300)

low.description: Swing low price (positive, below the high)

name: workflow.run_fibonacci_levels
title: Fibonacci Levels
